facts.fact: The plan, dated November 2017, states a National Cyber Security Authority has been established and its operationalisation is under way.
The plan states the government operationalised a CSIRT in 2010 that works 24/7 on surveillance of cyber threats to respond to and prevent incidents.

The plan lists a Cyber Security Policy among the policies in place that set a policy and operational framework for Rwanda's cyber resilience; it gives no date, so as_of is the plan's November 2017 imprint.
